name: e-commerce-root
description: Full-stack E-Commerce platform with Razorpay Test Mode integration

scripts.dev: node -e "import('child_process').then(({ spawn }) => { spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); });"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
